methodology.matching: confidence-ranked, per-image, person-class, highest-IoU unmatched ground truth; each GT matched once
methodology.ap: 101-point interpolated precision at recall 0.00, 0.01, ..., 1.00; all supplied person predictions
methodology.ground_truth: human_manual plus reviewed_by_human=true for every image

limitations: Person-only AP over supplied prediction records, not a complete COCO benchmark.
AP uses all supplied confidences; upstream detector confidence floors and candidate caps must be disclosed separately.
Unreviewed images are unknown, not negative images; predictions are never ground truth.
No crowd, ignore-region, area-range, or COCO maxDets handling is implemented.
evaluation_limits: Single short moving-camera source, no deployment generalization
Detector outputs capped at100 NMS0.45 person candidates perframe;AP conditional on these bounded outputs
Review boxes cover visible extents, not hidden full bodies
No crowd/ignore/area-ranges or full COCO benchmark semantics
CPU processing is not PipeGen TensorRT FP16 speed evidence
